rows.message: Let's battle!
rows.reply: Ha! Finally someone with guts. Don't cry when my team wipes yours.

rows.message: I challenge you. Right here, right now.
rows.reply: Two in one day? Route 2's getting popular. Fine, but don't blink — my team doesn't do slow.

rows.message: Bet you can't beat my team. Fight me.
rows.reply: Oh, a third one? Either Route 2's a magnet or you all heard my name. Let's see if your team's as loud as your mouth.

rows.message: On se fait un combat ?
rows.reply: Another one? Route 2's turning into a party today. Fine — let's see if you fight better than the last three.

rows.message: Want to trade? My Pidgey for your Rattata.
rows.reply: A Pidgey for my Rattata? Ha, you think I was born on Route 2 yesterday? Sweeten that deal or keep walking.

rows.message: Let's swap monsters, I'll give you my best one.
rows.reply: Best one, huh? Everybody says that. Show me the goods first or I'm not biting.

rows.message: Bye, I have to go.
rows.reply: Running off before you even said hello? Fine by me — saves us both time.

rows.message: Get lost, I'm busy.
rows.reply: Busy? Then quit blocking my road, pal.

rows.message: Nice weather today, isn't it?
rows.reply: Weather's fine. Your timing's not. You want a battle or a trade, or are you just here to talk about clouds?

rows.message: What's your favorite monster?
rows.reply: Favorite? Whatever's standing across from me when the whistle blows. You got one worth showing me, or just questions?

rows.message: I don't want to battle, I'm just looking around.
rows.reply: Looking's free. Standing on my route isn't. You got business here or what?

rows.message: How long have you been standing here?
rows.reply: Long enough to know nobody asks that unless they want something. You want a battle or a trade, or are you just counting my minutes?

rows.message: I'll take that sword. Here's the gold.
rows.reply: Hold your horses. Which sword, and whose gold? I've got three on the rack and none of them leave cheap.

rows.message: Sell me a blade, please, I can pay now.
rows.reply: Coin first, stranger. Then we talk steel. What kind of work are you putting it through?

rows.message: Hurry up, old woman, I don't have all day!
rows.reply: Old woman, is it? The door's behind you. Come back when you've got manners and coin.

rows.message: Your blades are junk and so are you.
rows.reply: Junk, is it? Then you won't mind walking out empty-handed. Door's where you found it.

rows.message: Thanks, goodbye!
rows.reply: Mind how you go. And mind the step — it's slick from the rain.

rows.message: What are you working on today?
rows.reply: A gate latch for the miller. Pays in flour, not coin, but his last hinge has held ten winters, so I don't mind.

rows.message: Is it hard, being a smith?
rows.reply: Hard? It's hot, loud, and my hands ache by dusk. What's it to you?

rows.message: I'm just looking, thanks.
rows.reply: Then look. Don't touch the edges — they're sharp, and I'm not bandaging strangers today.

rows.message: Let's battle!
rows.reply: Finally, someone who knows what they're for. My monsters have been bored all morning.

rows.message: I challenge you. Right here, right now.
rows.reply: Ha! Two in a row, and this one's got even less manners. Fine by me, my team's warmed up.

rows.message: Bet you can't beat my team. Fight me.
rows.reply: Ha! Another one with a mouth. That's three challengers before lunch — come on then, let's see if your team backs up your talk.

rows.message: On se fait un combat ?
rows.reply: A challenger who speaks my language — no small talk, just a fight. Fine, let's go, but don't cry when your team's in the dirt.

rows.message: Want to trade? My Pidgey for your Rattata.
rows.reply: Another Pidgey? Everyone's trying to pawn those off on me today. What's wrong with it — bad wing, or just ugly?

rows.message: Let's swap monsters, I'll give you my best one.
rows.reply: Best one, huh? Everyone says that. Show me what it is before I hand over anything of mine.

rows.message: Bye, I have to go.
rows.reply: Yeah, run along. Everybody's got somewhere to be when the battles get real.

rows.message: Get lost, I'm busy.
rows.reply: Busy? You walked up to me. Route 2's mine, so say your business or keep walking.

rows.message: Nice weather today, isn't it?
rows.reply: Weather's fine. You here to chat or to battle? Route 2 doesn't hand out free small talk.

rows.message: What's your favorite monster?
rows.reply: Depends who's asking. You gonna battle me or just chat?

rows.message: I don't want to battle, I'm just looking around.
rows.reply: Looking around's free. Standing in my spot while you do it isn't.

rows.message: How long have you been standing here?
rows.reply: Long enough to watch five trainers chicken out on me today. You here to make it six?

rows.message: I'll take that sword. Here's the gold.
rows.reply: Which sword? Point at it — I've got blades and blades, and I don't sell to a pointing finger and a promise. Gold first, in my hand.

rows.message: Sell me a blade, please, I can pay now.
rows.reply: Coin first, stranger. Then we talk steel. What kind of work are you putting it through?

rows.message: Hurry up, old woman, I don't have all day!
rows.reply: Old woman, is it? The forge runs on fire and patience, and you've brought neither. Come back when you've learned manners or grown a beard.

rows.message: Your blades are junk and so are you.
rows.reply: Junk, is it? Then your feet can carry you to a forge that suits you better. Door's behind you.

rows.message: Thanks, goodbye!
rows.reply: Don't let the door bruise you on the way out.

rows.message: What are you working on today?
rows.reply: Gate latch for the miller. Same thing I was working on an hour ago, and it won't finish itself while I stand here talking.

rows.message: Is it hard, being a smith?
rows.reply: Hard? It's hot, loud, and my hands ache by dusk. You're the second one today asking me that instead of buying something.

rows.message: I'm just looking, thanks.
rows.reply: Then look with your eyes, not your hands. Everything on the rack is oiled and sharp.
